featured_techniques.technique: Creating human connections that turn customers into brand ambassadors

sections.description: The speaker describes how raving fans are created by experiences and human connections, resulting in customers who actively spread the brand story as ambassadors.
sections.title: Earn the rave through experiences and human connections

sections.description: Interactions along the customer journey determine whether customers tell a great story, a not-so-great story, or remain mediocre; the authentic brand story is the one customers tell about who you are beyond marketing.
sections.title: Earning the right to the customer's story

summary: Jeanne Bliss discusses how organizations earn customer raves by crafting experiences and fostering genuine human connections. When a company earns the rave, customers become an army of mouthpieces who share the brand story, extending reach beyond advertising and PR. The talk emphasizes that the authentic story of a company lives in how it operates—its values, people, and decisions—rather than only in marketing materials. The core lesson is that the right to tell a customer’s story is earned through every interaction along the customer journey, with outcomes ranging from great, to not-so-great, to mediocre depending on performance.
title: Earn the Rave: Turning Customers into Brand Ambassadors
topics: earning the right to the customer's story
